text.en: The deposited USDC is held in Liquidity
text.zh-TW: 存入的 USDC 放在 Liquidity

text.en: The fToken pulls USDC from the Safe with `transferFrom` through the Liquidity contract
text.zh-TW: fToken 經 Liquidity 合約用 `transferFrom` 從 Safe 拉走 USDC

text.en: Usable. The tokens are actually held in Fluid's Liquidity contract, and at every signing the program checks that its code is unchanged. Send a small amount the first time.
text.zh-TW: 可以用。代幣實際放在 Fluid 的 Liquidity 合約，程式每次簽名都確認它的程式碼沒變；第一次先送小額。

pastTxsConclusion.en: The only Safe transaction that does not fit calls `deposit` on another contract, which then deposits into fUSDC. That is not the Fluid app's route.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 唯一不合的 Safe 交易呼叫的是別的合約的 `deposit`，由那個合約再存進 fUSDC，不是 Fluid app 的路線。

text.en: fUSDC held about 283 million USDC a year ago, about 314 million in 2026-01, and about 135 million now. From 2026-05 to 06 it lost about 83 million in one month, at the same time as the reward private key incident (Fluid says the lending pools were not affected). 2,128 addresses hold it, and the top 10 hold 39.24%.
text.zh-TW: fUSDC 一年前約 2.83 億 USDC，2026-01 到約 3.14 億，現在約 1.35 億；2026-05 到 06 一個月少了約 8,300 萬，跟獎勵私鑰事件同期（Fluid 說借貸池未受影響）。2,128 個地址持有，前 10 名占 39.24%。

recommendation.en: This pool has existed for more than a year. Fluid's withdrawal limits may delay a large withdrawal, so before you deposit, plan when you will withdraw.
recommendation.zh-TW: 這是存在超過一年的池子；大額提領可能受 Fluid 的提款上限延後，存入前想好何時要提。

role.en: Fluid's USDC lending pool token (fUSDC): takes USDC and issues shares
role.zh-TW: Fluid 的 USDC 借貸池代幣（fUSDC），收 USDC、發股份

text.en: Etherscan: verified contract name fToken. Its creation transaction was sent by 0x8e7fb4d4fabc504a4ad73d44e09080cb68960098 and deployed it through CREATE3
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：已驗證合約名 fToken，建立交易由 0x8e7fb4d4fabc504a4ad73d44e09080cb68960098 送出，經 CREATE3 部署
